correctness.rationale: For the explicit family, the unique characteristic-five singularity is an ordinary node. Finiteness of the relative line scheme follows from rigidity of off-node lines and a six-point Bezout bound on through-node directions. Four equations in relative Gr(2,4), plus the finite generic fiber of degree 27, prove finite flat rank 27. Fifteen simple pairing lines and six nonreduced node lines account for all 27 units of special length. Cyclotomic Pluecker ratios provide integral quadratic sections and show their nilpotent parameter is nonzero modulo five, giving an isomorphism of complete finite free coordinate algebras by Nakayama. The exact F5 checker was executed; completeness is proved geometrically.

value.rationale: This is a complete scheme-theoretic arithmetic classification of the natural relative Fano scheme at its bad reduction prime. The exact six ramified quadratic orders determine specialization, nonreduced local rings, inertia action and residue fields, not merely a finite rational-line count or a renaming of the general nodal 21-line theorem. The arithmetic order is useful for integral descent and local monodromy of this classical surface.
